citation_coverage.rationale: Paths and line spans accompany the substantive test and implementation claims.

citation_entailment.rationale: Inspected slices substantiate the assertions, callback ordering, context creation and manual invocation explanation.

source_authority.rationale: Evidence consists of the assigned snapshot's tests and implementation.

tool_navigation.rationale: Retrieved the relevant test and implementation slices; supplied evidence shows read-only navigation.

uncertainty.rationale: Clearly separates test assertions, implementation observations and uninspected helper internals.

unsupported_extras.rationale: Additional parsing, result-processing and Context.invoke claims are supported by inspected slices.

usability.rationale: Directly answers the requested comparison and ordering without claiming execution.

units.rationale: Identifies the correct test and its manually implemented fallback when invoked_subcommand is None.
Accurately reports the explicit sync invocation, absence of an exception, and exact ordered output.
Accurately reports the no-selection invocation, absence of an exception, and fallback output followed by child output.

Correctly orders resolution, invoked_subcommand assignment, group callback, child context creation and invocation. Explicitly excludes chain guarantees and distinguishes implementation reading from test assertions.
